_comment: What foundry_pull.py fetches, and how it is tagged. Folder roots are pulled whole (General/<bucket>/<Character>/<tier actors>); listed actors are pulled individually and grouped under the named character.

actors.note: the 100 XP actor with the completed twenty questions; the other Shinjō Harunobu actor (FCqx2vUqaoQHEK5w) has none

campaigns._comment: campaign tag by character slug; anything not listed has no campaign

corrections._comment: field fixes applied on extract; the Foundry record has the typo

nasu-kogo._why: Foundry records 'Shoshuro Shadoweaver School'; the compendium roll spells it 'Shosuro Shadowweaver School'

tonbo-asahi.identity.school: Dragonfly Grace of the Spirits School
tonbo-asahi._why: Foundry records 'Dragonfly Grace of the Spirits'; the compendium roll has ' School'

portraits._comment: portrait path per slug, relative to the repo root

_derive_tiers_comment: characters Foundry holds at one point only; scripts/derive_tiers.py rebuilds their earlier XP tiers
